entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: The Strixhaven college of elemental arts, focused on artistic expression, performance and fiery passion; its colors are blue and red.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The university on Arcavios that contains the Prismari college.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Strixhaven University stands.

entities.name: Galazeth Prismari
entities.description: The elder dragon who founded the Prismari college.

entities.name: Uvilda
entities.description: A Djinn, the blue-aligned dean of Prismari (later described as former and deceased).

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: An Efreet, the red-aligned dean of Prismari.

entities.name: Veyran
entities.description: Listed among the Prismari deans as the blue dean.

entities.name: Conjurot Hall
entities.description: A tower on the Prismari campus where Uvilda and Nassari have apartments and workshops.

entities.name: Furygale
entities.description: A dangerous warded region of the Prismari campus full of abandoned magical creations and rogue elementals.

entities.name: Opus Walk
entities.description: A path through the central campus displaying Prismari elemental creations.

entities.name: Seichebasin
entities.description: A lake of blended temperatures prone to nasty weather.

events.summary: Galazeth Prismari founded the Prismari college at Strixhaven.
events.quote: It was founded by the elder dragon Galazeth Prismari
